summary: Cessna 182G Skylane N3147S suffered engine trouble shortly after takeoff from Glenwood Springs Municipal Airport and flipped onto its back during a forced landing in a field beside the Rio Grande Trail; the pilot was trapped and had to be extricated by emergency crews; the pilot was seriously injured and the passenger received minor injuries, and both were taken to Valley View Hospital.
location: Field next to the Rio Grande Trail ~5 mi south of Glenwood Springs Municipal Airport, west side of Highway 82 at ~8-mile mark, near Cattle Creek
responding_agency: Carbondale and Rural Fire Protection District; Garfield County Sheriff's Office
